title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: TempoKV：面向自回归视频生成的预测式 KV 缓存量化

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose TempoKV , a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. TempoKV predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that TempoKV consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to 6.71 × 6.71\times KV cache compression with the best overall quality–efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型支持长视频的流式生成，但由于 KV 缓存的快速增长，会面临严重的内存开销问题。 现有的 KV 缓存量化方法主要为大型语言模型（LLM）设计，难以有效迁移到视频模型，因为视频模型的激活值具有不同的统计特性和强烈的时空冗余性。 我们观察到，视频 KV 缓存在时间维度上基本是可预测的，且存在明显的非对称性。 键（Key）可以通过其时间历史高度预测，而值（Value）主要取决于当前的键，并需要少量前序值的短期历史。 基于这些观察结果，我们提出了 TempoKV——一个无需训练的、用于自回归视频生成的预测式 KV 缓存量化框架。 TempoKV 根据键和值的不同依赖关系分别进行预测，并仅以低精度存储残差部分。 两个预测器均轻量级，只需通过少量 BF16 样本的线性回归进行一次离线校准，并在所有提示词和生成过程中保持固定不变。 在 Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing 和 LongCat-Video-13B 上的实验表明，TempoKV 在相当或更高的压缩比下，始终能实现优于现有 KV 缓存量化方法的生成质量，最高可达 6.71 × 6.71\times 的 KV 缓存压缩率，并在质量与效率之间实现了最佳平衡。 我们的代码将在 GitHub 上发布。

paragraphs.en: Recent video diffusion models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) have achieved high generation quality, but extending generation to long-duration videos still requires significant computation and memory. Autoregressive approaches address this limitation by generating videos progressively while reusing previously generated context ( Huang et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . However, the resulting KV cache becomes another bottleneck, as its size grows linearly with generation duration and quickly dominates GPU memory. For example, in Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , generating a 45-second 480p video requires 51.76 GB solely for the KV cache when stored in BF16, exceeding the memory of most consumer GPUs and limiting further extension of the generation horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频扩散模型（Wan 等，2025；Wu 等，2025）已实现了高生成质量，但将生成扩展到长时间视频时，仍然需要大量的计算资源和内存。 自回归方法通过逐步生成视频并重复利用先前生成的上下文来解决这一限制（Huang 等，2025a；Zhu 等，2026；Liu 等，2026）。 然而，由此产生的 KV 缓存会成为另一个瓶颈，因为其大小会随着生成时长线性增长，并迅速占据 GPU 内存。 例如，在因果强制法（Causal Forcing）中（Zhu 等，2026），生成一个 45 秒的 480p 视频时，仅 KV 缓存就需要 51.76 GB（以 BF16 格式存储），这超过了大多数消费级 GPU 的内存容量，并限制了生成时间窗口的进一步扩展。

paragraphs.en: Existing KV cache quantization methods ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Ashkboos et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2024 ; Hooper et al., 2024 ) are developed primarily for large language models (LLMs), focusing on the numerical characteristics of language KV caches. sents.zh: 然而，自回归视频扩散模型表现出不同的激活分布以及连续潜在帧之间的强时空冗余性，这使得这些方法直接迁移到视频模型中并非最佳选择。

paragraphs.en: Recent work, QVG ( Xi et al., 2026 ) , takes an important step toward video-specific quantization by grouping similar video tokens and subtracting group centroid. Notably, QVG observes different compression behavior between keys (K) and values (V): the same smoothing operation reduces the quantization error of keys much more than that of values. Despite this discrepancy, it applies the same similarity-based formula to both. This difference suggests that video KV redundancy is not fully captured by token similarity alone. To further investigate, we analyze how the KV cache changes over latent frames and whether this evolution is predictable. As shown in the top row of Fig. 1 , keys evolve smoothly and predictably along the latent frames, while values are markedly more irregular.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究 QVG（Xi 等人，2026）通过将相似的视频标记分组并减去组中心点，在面向视频的量化方面迈出了重要一步。 值得注意的是，QVG 观察到键（K）和值（V）在压缩行为上存在差异：相同的平滑操作对键的量化误差的降低效果远大于对值的量化误差。 尽管存在这种差异，该研究仍对两者应用了相同的基于相似性的公式。 这种差异表明，仅凭标记相似性无法完全捕捉视频 KV 的冗余性。 为了进一步探究，我们分析了 KV 缓存在潜在帧上的变化方式，以及这种演变是否具有可预测性。 如图 1 最上面一行所示，键沿着潜在帧平滑且可预测地演变，而值的变化则明显更为不规则。

sents.zh: 为了进一步探究，我们分析了 KV 缓存在潜在帧上的变化方式，以及这种演变是否具有可预测性。

sents.en: As shown in the top row of Fig. 1 , keys evolve smoothly and predictably along the latent frames, while values are markedly more irregular.
sents.zh: 如图 1 最上面一行所示，键沿着潜在帧平滑且可预测地演变，而值的变化则明显更为不规则。

paragraphs.en: We find a clear asymmetry between keys and values. The current key can be accurately predicted from preceding keys at the same spatial position: a linear probe on the key history reaches a cosine similarity of 0.877. Values show a different pattern. Previous values alone are far less predictive of the current value, reaching a cosine similarity of only 0.637, which rises to 0.881 once the aligned current key is included, i.e., the key at the same latent frame and spatial position.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现键与值之间存在明显的不对称性。 当前键可以通过同一空间位置的前序键进行准确预测：对键历史进行线性探测时，余弦相似度可达 0.877。 值则呈现出不同的模式。 仅凭之前的值对当前值的预测能力要弱得多，余弦相似度仅为 0.637；一旦加入与之对齐的当前键（即同一潜在帧和空间位置上的键），该相似度会提升至 0.881。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this observation, we introduce TempoKV , a predictive KV cache quantization framework for autoregressive video generation. TempoKV first predicts the key K t K_{t} from reconstructed historical keys, then quantizes only its residual. After reconstructing the current key, TempoKV uses the reconstructed key K ^ t \widehat{K}_{t} and reconstructed historical values to predict the current value V t V_{t} , and again quantizes the remaining residual. As shown in Fig. 1 , prediction suppresses prominent outliers and narrows the dynamic range, producing low-magnitude residuals that are easier to quantize.
paragraphs.zh: 受这一观察的启发，我们提出了 TempoKV——一种用于自回归视频生成的预测式 KV 缓存量化框架。 TempoKV 首先根据重构的历史键预测当前键 K t K_{t}，然后仅对其残差进行量化。 在重构当前键后，TempoKV 利用重构的键 K ^ t \widehat{K}_{t} 和重构的历史值来预测当前值 V t V_{t}，并再次对剩余的残差进行量化。 如图 1 所示，预测过程抑制了显著的异常值并缩小了动态范围，从而产生幅度较小的残差，这些残差更容易进行量化。

paragraphs.en: This asymmetry has two further implications for quantization. First, the aligned current K provides the primary predictive signal for V, while additional V history offers only limited benefit. In contrast, K relies mainly on its own temporal history and benefits from a longer context. This suggests using a shorter temporal context for V than for K. Second, the asymmetry also affects precision allocation. Quantization error in K not only degrades its own reconstruction, but is also carried into the subsequent V prediction through the cross predictor. This makes K more sensitive to error. Accordingly, we assign K a higher precision than V except at the lowest-precision INT2 setting.
paragraphs.zh: 这种不对称性对量化还有两个进一步的含义。 首先，对齐后的当前 K 为 V 提供了主要的预测信号，而额外的 V 历史信息只能带来有限的帮助。 相比之下，K 主要依赖其自身的时间序列历史，并且能从更长的上下文获益。 这表明 V 应使用比 K 更短的时间上下文。 其次，这种不对称性也会影响精度的分配。 K 的量化误差不仅会劣化其自身的重建效果，还会通过交叉预测器传递到后续的 V 预测中。 这使得 K 对误差更为敏感。 因此，除了精度最低的 INT2 设置外，我们将 K 的精度设定得高于 V。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) , Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and LongCat-Video-13B ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2025 ) validate the asymmetric predictive structure and demonstrate its effectiveness for low-bit KV compression. TempoKV improves generation quality over existing low-bit KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to 6.71 × \mathbf{6.71\times} . These gains remain robust across diverse autoregressive generation frameworks and resolutions, indicating that the KV asymmetry is not specific to a single backbone.

paragraphs.en: Asymmetric Predictive Dependencies. We identify that K and V exhibit asymmetric predictive dependencies across latent frames. Keys are highly predictable from their history, whereas values benefit from the aligned current key in addition to previous values. Through layer-wise and temporal analysis, we show that this asymmetry is consistent across layers and throughout generation.

paragraphs.en: Recent autoregressive video models generate extended sequences causally while reusing previously generated context. To bridge bidirectional diffusion and causal generation, CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) adapts pretrained bidirectional diffusion models into autoregressive generators through distribution matching distillation, while Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025a ) reduces exposure bias by training on autoregressive rollouts with self-generated outputs. Self-Forcing++ ( Cui et al., 2026 ) further mitigates long-horizon error accumulation using teacher guidance on self-generated videos. Other works extend long-horizon generation through joint denoising and attention sinks ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , frame-level autoregression with short-window attention ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , chunk-wise prediction ( Teng et al., 2025 ) , frame-context packing ( Zhang and Agrawala, 2025 ) , or explicit memory mechanisms ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Henschel et al., 2024 ) . LongCat-Video-13B ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2025 ) adopts video continuation pretraining with coarse-to-fine generation. However, these AR approaches rely on historical context. Consequently, the linearly growing KV cache rapidly dominates GPU memory, becoming a severe bottleneck for high-resolution and long-video generation.

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the growing KV-cache memory bottleneck, early efforts in LLMs selectively retain important context, such as attention sinks together with a recent window ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) , recent and heavy-hitter tokens ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , or clustered important KV positions identified from an observation window ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Recent video-specific methods adapt cache management to autoregressive video. PaFu-KV ( Chen et al., 2026 ) models time-heterogeneous token importance with a Salience Estimation Head distilled from a bidirectional teacher, while FutureForcing ( Luo et al., 2026 ) uses future query proxies to guide token eviction and merging. Others use heterogeneous memory allocation (DummyForcing ( Guo et al., 2026 ) ) or hybrid static and dynamic pruning (Forcing-KV ( Ji et al., 2026 ) ), while PackCache ( Li et al., 2026 ) dynamically compacts the cache through condition anchoring and cross-frame decay modeling.

paragraphs.en: LLM KV-cache quantization spans several directions. KIVI ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and KVQuant ( Hooper et al., 2024 ) adapt quantization to the distinct distributions of KV through asymmetric quantization granularity and non-uniform quantization. QuaRot ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ) and RotateKV ( Su et al., 2025 ) use rotations to mitigate the effect of outliers, while SKVQ ( Duanmu et al., 2024 ) and ZipCache ( He et al., 2024 ) retain recent or salient tokens at higher precision. PQCache ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and CommVQ ( Li et al., 2025 ) further explore product and vector quantization. Despite this diversity, these methods target language-model KV statistics. QVG ( Xi et al., 2026 ) extends low-bit KV quantization to autoregressive video generation by leveraging spatiotemporal redundancy with Semantic-Aware Smoothing, followed by coarse-to-fine Progressive Residual Quantization. TempoKV takes a complementary predictive view: rather than grouping similar tokens, it models the temporal dependencies of K and V and uses their asymmetry to guide the quantization design.

paragraphs.en: Keys and values also require different precision. Key quantization perturbs the attention logits before softmax and can alter the resulting attention weights. paragraphs.en: We evaluate TempoKV on three autoregressive video generation models: Self-Forcing-Wan-1.3B ( Huang et al., 2025a ) , Causal Forcing-Wan-1.3B ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and LongCat-Video-13B ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2025 ) . We compare against three groups of baselines: (1)video-specific KV cache quantization, represented by QVG ( Xi et al., 2026 ) and QVG-Pro, (2)general-purpose KV cache quantization, including RTN, KIVI ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and QuaRot ( Ashkboos et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate all video generation on the first 128 prompts from MovieGen ( Polyak et al., 2024 ) , using VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025b ) metrics to assess perceptual video quality. paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 reports the memory and latency cost of KV cache compression on Self-Forcing. At INT4, TempoKV reduces the KV cache from 48.18 48.18 GB to 13.2 GB and peak memory usage falls from 68.27 68.27 GB to 35.59 GB . Under the more aggressive INT2 setting, peak memory usage further decreases to 30.63 GB , while LPIPS remains at 0.13 . Notably, this exceeds the INT4 quality of QVG while using 6.1 6.1 GB less peak memory. Decoding the compressed cache during attention adds latency. On our hardware, TempoKV adds only 11.9% generation overhead to the BF16 latency of 337.9 337.9 s, against 15.5 % 15.5\% for QVG, 23.5 % 23.5\% to 25.2 % 25.2\% for RTN and KIVI, and 103.9 % 103.9\% for QuaRot. This overhead changes by less than 1 1 s from INT2 to INT4, whereas that of QVG grows by 9.9 9.9 s. Together, these results show that TempoKV preserves generation quality while reducing both KV storage and runtime memory, with minimal overhead.

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate long-horizon generation on Self-Forcing by extending the rollout to 1401 frames, corresponding to approximately 90 seconds. paragraphs.en: Fig. 7 (a–b) compares the normalized reconstruction error at different effective bit-widths. For K, temporal prediction lowers the error at every bit-width, by a factor of 3.27 × 3.27\times at INT2. For V, temporal prediction alone reduces the error by 1.42 × 1.42\times while adding the cross predictor raises the reduction to 2.19 × 2.19\times . The lower error propagates to video quality. Fig. 7 (c) reports the VBench-Long score difference between the cross predictor and the temporal-only predictor. Visual Quality improves from 68.77 68.77 to 74.10 74.10 . The gain is concentrated in Imaging Quality ( + 13.44 +13.44 ), followed by Aesthetic Quality ( + 1.49 +1.49 ). Background Consistency, Subject Consistency and Motion Smoothness change by less than 0.8 0.8 . These three dimensions already exceed 95 95 without the cross predictor and are close to saturation. Consistency scores can also be raised by generating more static video. However, cross predictor’s Dynamic Degree increases by 2.13 2.13 , indicating that consistency scores were not maintained at the expense of reducing the magnitude of motion.

paragraphs.en: Sec. 3.2 argues that K should be given higher precision than V. Table 4 validates this design under different allocation schemes. At 4.73 × 4.73\times , k4v2 substantially outperforms the reversed k2v4 allocation, improving PSNR from 19.83 19.83 to 23.17 and reducing FID from 10.28 10.28 to 5.23 . The same pattern appears at 5.55 × 5.55\times , where k3v2 clearly outperforms k2v3 . The two directions of Table 4 are also asymmetric. Holding K at 2 bits and raising V from 2 to 4 leaves video quality virtually unchanged, while the compression ratio drops from 6.71 × \times to 4.73 × \times . Holding V at 2 bits and raising K from 2 to 4 improves PSNR by 3.3, from 19.85 to 23.17 . This further supports allocating additional precision to K rather than distributing the budget uniformly between K and V. However, values cannot be assigned excessively low precision. With 1-bit values, the quality collapses sharply.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce TempoKV , a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for autoregressive video generation. TempoKV exploits asymmetric dependencies between keys and values. Keys are predictable from their own history, while values depend mainly on the aligned current key. It predicts both accordingly, quantizes only the residuals, and assigns keys higher precision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TempoKV substantially improves low-bit KV reconstruction and achieves up to 6.71 × 6.71\times cache compression, while delivering the best generation quality and compression–quality trade-off compared with existing KV cache quantization work.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 TempoKV——一种无需训练的预测式 KV 缓存量化框架，适用于自回归视频生成。 TempoKV 利用了键与值之间的非对称依赖关系。 键可以通过其自身历史进行预测，而值则主要依赖于与之对齐的当前键。 它据此对两者进行预测，仅对残差进行量化，并赋予键更高的精度。 大量实验表明，TempoKV 显著提升了低比特 KV 的重建效果，实现了高达 6.71 × 6.71\times 的缓存压缩，同时在生成质量和压缩-质量权衡方面优于现有的 KV 缓存量化方法。

paragraphs.en: Predictability varies substantially across layers but remains stable over time. With temporal prediction alone, the layer-wise cosine similarity ranges from 0.827 to 0.990 for K and from 0.263 to nearly 1.0 for V. Adding the aligned cache preserves this large layer-wise variation. In contrast, the variation across latent frames is much smaller: K + aligned V remains between 0.909 and 0.924, while V + aligned K stays between 0.581 and 0.625. Across all four predictors, the layer-wise variation is approximately 3 × 3\times – 13 × 13\times larger than the temporal variation. This layer-dependent but temporally stable behavior supports the design of TempoKV: we fit a separate predictor for each layer and head and reuse it across all latent frames. These results show that the asymmetric predictive dependencies identified in Sec. 3.2 persist across different autoregressive video models.

paragraphs.en: We further test whether the cross prediction between K and V depends on its direction by reversing the predictor from K → \to V to V → \to K, with the rest of the compression pipeline unchanged. As shown in Table 6 , K → \to V achieves better reconstruction quality across all bit allocations. The gap is particularly large at low precision. Under k4v2 , reversing the direction reduces PSNR from 23.17 to 17.71 and increases FID from 5.23 to 73.80 . The difference remains at higher precision, e.g. k5v3 and k6v4 . These results indicate that the aligned key is a better predictor of values, which supports the K → \to V direction and the asymmetric bit allocation in TempoKV.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of TempoKV at higher resolutions, we conduct experiments on LongCat-Video-13B at 720p under INT4 quantization. As shown in Table 8 , TempoKV k5v3 achieves the highest compression ratio of 3.65 × 3.65\times while also providing the best reconstruction fidelity, with a PSNR of 17.31 17.31 , SSIM of 0.77 0.77 , LPIPS of 0.12 0.12 , and FID of 11.20 11.20 . paragraphs.en: We first vary the number of calibration prompts from 1 to 32. The K predictor is particularly data-efficient: a single prompt already achieves a reconstruction error within 0.3 % 0.3\% of that obtained with 32 prompts. The cross predictor benefits more from additional calibration data, with its error decreasing by 17.6 % 17.6\% from 1 to 8 prompts. Beyond eight prompts, however, the improvement quickly saturates, with only a further 2.1 % 2.1\% reduction from 8 to 32 prompts. We use 8 calibration prompts by default to collect the BF16 traces for predictor fitting. These results show that a small calibration set is sufficient to obtain stable predictors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先将校准提示词的数量从 1 个变化到 32 个。 K 预测器尤其具有数据高效性：仅用单个提示词，其重建误差就已达到使用 32 个提示词时结果的 0.3% 以内（0.3\%）。 交叉预测器从额外的校准数据中获益更多，当提示词数量从 1 个增加到 8 个时，其误差降低了 17.6%（17.6\%）。 然而，超过 8 个提示词后，改进效果迅速饱和，从 8 个增加到 32 个提示词时，误差仅进一步减少了 2.1%（2.1\%）。 我们默认使用 8 个校准提示词来收集用于预测器拟合的 BF16 轨迹。 这些结果表明，只需一个较小的校准集即可获得稳定的预测器。

paragraphs.en: We next calibrate the predictors separately on the action and scene sets and evaluate each predictor on both distributions. Using a mismatched calibration set changes the reconstruction error by at most 0.77 % 0.77\% across K and V. Moreover, the change is not consistently negative: cross-distribution calibration slightly improves some settings while slightly degrading others. The predictors are therefore largely insensitive to the content distribution of the calibration set. Together with the small calibration requirement above, this makes TempoKV lightweight to calibrate and removes the need for a large or carefully matched calibration corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们分别对动作集和场景集校准预测器，并在两种分布上评估每个预测器。 使用不匹配的校准集会使重建误差在 K 和 V 上的变化最多不超过 0.77%（0.77\%）。 此外，这种变化并非始终为负：跨分布校准在某些设置中略有改善，而在另一些设置中则略有恶化。 因此，这些预测器对校准集的内容分布基本不敏感。 结合上述较低的校准需求，这使得 TempoKV 的校准过程非常轻量，也无需使用大型或经过精心匹配的校准语料库。

paragraphs.en: We compare TempoKV with Forcing-KV ( Ji et al., 2026 ) , which reduces KV cache memory by pruning cached tokens. Table 9 reports generation quality. On Causal Forcing, Forcing-KV reaches a PSNR of 9.32 and an FID of 40.07, while TempoKV in its lowest-bit configuration reaches 17.23 and 9.15. The gap is larger on Self-Forcing, where Forcing-KV reaches 9.44 and 83.86 and TempoKV reaches 19.85 and 10.04. Higher-bit configurations of TempoKV improve fidelity further, and all TempoKV configurations score higher than Forcing-KV in Visual Quality. Compared with token pruning, quantization preserves more information from each cached token and yields higher fidelity. Token pruning, in turn, reduces attention computation and can accelerate generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 TempoKV 与 Forcing-KV（Ji et al., 2026）进行了比较，后者通过剪枝缓存的标记来减少 KV 缓存的内存占用。 表 9 报告了生成质量。 在因果强制（Causal Forcing）任务中，Forcing-KV 的 PSNR 达到 9.32，FID 为 40.07；而 TempoKV 在其最低位配置下的 PSNR 和 FID 分别达到 17.23 和 9.15。 在自强制（Self-Forcing）任务中，这一差距更大：Forcing-KV 的 PSNR 和 FID 分别为 9.44 和 83.86，而 TempoKV 则达到 19.85 和 10.04。 TempoKV 的更高位配置进一步提升了保真度，并且在视觉质量方面，所有 TempoKV 配置的成绩均高于 Forcing-KV。 与标记剪枝相比，量化能够保留每个缓存标记中的更多信息，从而带来更高的保真度。 而标记剪枝则能减少注意力计算量，从而加快生成速度。
